passages.text: Flora-On botanical account for Aphanes cornucopioides. Geographic scope: Portugal; habitat descriptions and native status on this site refer to Portugal, not the global native range.
Ecologia Pousios, montados, clareiras de matos e bosques, campos de cultivo, prados e pastagens anuais.

passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Alchemilla cornucopioides (Lag.) Roem. & Schult..
The native range of this species is W. Medit. It is an annual and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
